textSummary.channelOverview: AccuWeather NOW (CH 101) is a premier United States channel broadcasting Weather & Climate programming.

textSummary.corporateAndLocation: Responsible Network / Operator: AccuWeather Inc.. Origin: United States (State College, PA).
textSummary.signalQualityVerdict: Broadcast stream verified at 1920x1080 (1080p FHD) with standard 16:9 aspect fit. Measured latency: 42 ms.
textSummary.soundQualityAssessment: Stereo AAC stream processed through Web Audio AGC loudness normalizer (-14 LUFS target).
